title: Speaker focus · gentle-stream console
brief: Subtle wall-glass music console in the existing speaker focus: measured audio spectrum, transport shortcuts, volume, listening range and discreet cartoon speaker waves. No solid or distorted panel.

artboards.title: Wall console
artboards.tradeoff: Compact centered glass console; strongest gentle-stream resemblance without covering either speaker.

artboards.title: Split console
artboards.tradeoff: Spectrum and transport on the left, volume/range always visible on the right; wider but faster to tune.

artboards.title: Spectral ribbon
artboards.tradeoff: Shallow horizontal strip leaves more wall visible; smaller spectrum and denser controls.
